matches.title: Espanyol vs Real Madrid
matches.description: Watch Espanyol vs Real Madrid highlights and goals from La Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 3, 2026. On a high-stakes evening in La Liga , Espanyol hosted the league giants Real Madrid in a match that promised tactical intrigue and physical confrontation. With both sides desperate for points as the season nears its climax, the atmosphere was electric from the opening whistle. A Physical and Frustrating Opening Half Taking place on May 3, 2026 , the contest began with Real Madrid looking to dictate the tempo through the delivery of Trent Alexander-Arnold . The English fullback was active early on, swinging in multiple corners as the visitors sought an aerial breakthrough. However, the opening 45 minutes were defined more by a flurry of cautions than clinical finishing. Brahim Diaz and Vinicius Junior both saw yellow cards within a minute of each other for the visitors, with the latter booked for unsportsmanlike conduct. Espanyol ’s Omar El Hilali also found himself in the referee's book as the game turned into a physical battle in the middle of the park. Despite the frequent interruptions, both goalkeepers were called into action to maintain the deadlock. Aurelien Tchouameni and Federico Valverde both directed powerful headers toward the target, but Espanyol 's Marko Dmitrovic proved equal to the task with a series of comfortable saves. At the other end, Andriy Lunin was forced to stay sharp just before the interval, safely clutching a goal-bound header from Leandro Cabrera after an Edu Exposito corner. As the teams headed into the tunnels, the match remained balanced on a knife-edge, characterized by high possession for the visitors and gritty defensive work from the hosts. The Vinicius Junior Breakthrough The second half saw Real Madrid emerge with renewed attacking intent, despite an early caution for Trent Alexander-Arnold . The turning point arrived shortly after the 50th minute when Carlo Ancelotti introduced Gonzalo Garcia for Brahim Diaz . The substitution paid immediate dividends in the 55th minute. Vinicius Junior initiated a fluid team move, and after receiving a perfectly weighted assist from Gonzalo Garcia , the Brazilian winger clinical finished with his right foot to break the deadlock and silence the home crowd. Espanyol nearly offered an immediate response when Ramon Terrats unleashed a powerful strike from outside the area, but the ball whistled agonizingly wide of the frame. That missed opportunity proved costly just a minute later. In the 66th minute, Real Madrid doubled their advantage with another stunning team goal. Vinicius Junior was once again the architect and the executioner; after a sublime assist from Jude Bellingham , the Brazilian found the net for the second time in the match, effectively seizing control of the tie. Professional Management and Late Pressure With a two-goal cushion, Real Madrid looked to manage their resources, introducing Eduardo Camavinga and Cesar Palacios to solidify the midfield. Espanyol manager reacted with a triple substitution, bringing on Pere Milla , Kike Garcia , and Jofre Carreras in a desperate attempt to find a way back into the game. While the hosts pushed forward, earning several corners and a late long-range effort from Carlos Romero , they struggled to break down a disciplined Madrid backline. As the clock ticked into five minutes of added time, Real Madrid remained the more likely to score again. Jude Bellingham forced a late save from Dmitrovic following a counter-attack led by Franco Mastantuono . By the time the final whistle blew, the visitors had asserted their dominance with 67% of the possession, leaving Espanyol to reflect on a spirited but ultimately fruitless effort against the clinical efficiency of Vinicius Junior .

matches.description: Watch Real Madrid vs Athletic Club highlights and goals from La Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 23, 2026. On May 23, 2026 , the historic rivalry between Real Madrid and Athletic Club took center stage in a La Liga match that promised high intensity and tactical complexity. Both sides stepped onto the pitch with everything to play for, creating an electric atmosphere from the very first whistle. Early Dominance and Clinical Finishing Real Madrid wasted little time in establishing their authority on the game. In the 12th minute, Daniel Carvajal provided a precise assist for Gonzalo Garcia , who composed himself to slot the ball home with his right foot. While the visitors attempted to claw their way back, the home side remained relentless. Jude Bellingham , despite picking up an early yellow card for a robust challenge, proved his worth just before the break. In the 41st minute, he connected perfectly with a cross from Thiago Pitarch , unleashing a left-footed volley that flew into the back of the net to double the lead. Athletic’s Resilience and the Second Half Surge Just as it seemed the hosts would coast into the interval, Athletic Club struck back with a moment of pure quality. In first-half stoppage time, Inaki Williams found Gorka Guruzeta , who produced a stunning volley to reduce the deficit. The momentum shifted briefly, but Real Madrid regained control early in the second half. In the 51st minute, Alvaro Carreras teed up Kylian Mbappe outside the area; the Frenchman took the shot early, beating the keeper with a powerful right-footed strike to restore the two-goal cushion. Late VAR Drama and Final Exchanges The closing stages were defined by tactical substitutions and the intervention of technology. Brahim Diaz , introduced as a substitute, appeared to have added a fourth in the 88th minute after another assist from Thiago Pitarch . Following a tense VAR review, the referee confirmed the goal. Athletic Club refused to go quietly, however, as Urko Izeta headed home from an Inaki Williams cross in the 91st minute. Despite the late consolation for the Basques, Real Madrid finished the match with a dominant 74% possession, securing a hard-fought victory in front of their home fans.

matches.title: Sevilla vs Real Madrid
matches.description: Watch Sevilla vs Real Madrid highlights and goals from La Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 17, 2026. On May 17, 2026 , the lights of La Liga shone brightly on a clash between two of Spanish football's most iconic institutions. Sevilla hosted Real Madrid in a match defined by tactical discipline and moments of high drama that kept the supporters on the edge of their seats until the very end. Vinícius Júnior Breaks the Deadlock The contest exploded into life in the 15th minute when Vinícius Júnior found the back of the net with a clinical right-footed finish. The goal was immediately subjected to a VAR review, leading to a tense silence across the stadium before the referee pointed to the center circle to confirm the strike. This early breakthrough set the tone for a match where margins were razor-thin and every decision felt monumental. Drama followed shortly after when the VAR was called into action again in the 24th minute to assess a potential penalty for the visitors following a blocked effort by Antonio Rüdiger , though no foul was given. The controversy shifted to the other end just before halftime. Sevilla fans erupted as the referee paused play for another VAR check on a possible penalty for the hosts, but after a thorough review, the initial call stood, leaving the home side frustrated as they headed into the interval. Resilience and Tactical Battles The second half saw Sevilla introduce fresh legs, with Alexis Sánchez and Chidera Ejuke brought on to spark a comeback. The hosts ramped up the pressure, testing the Madrid defense with headers from Akor Adams and Andrés Castrín , but Thibaut Courtois remained a formidable barrier. The Belgian goalkeeper's positioning was flawless, claiming crosses and stopping goalbound efforts to preserve the lead. As the clock ticked down, the match became increasingly physical. Yellow cards were issued for dissent to Alexis Sánchez and Lucien Agoumé as frustrations boiled over. Real Madrid had chances to double their advantage, notably through Kylian Mbappé , who struggled with offside calls and a missed volley late on. Despite a desperate final surge from Sevilla in stoppage time, featuring blocked shots from Ejuke and Kike Salas , the visitors held firm to secure a vital away victory.
